abstract: DAZ-like 1( DAZL1) is a germ cell-specific protein expressed in both male and female gonads. The DAZL1 gene, which maps to chromosome 3 in humans, is an autosomal homologue to the Deleted in AZoospermia ( DAZ) gene(s) located on the Y chromosome. We studied the expression of DAZL1 by means of immunohistochemistry in order to determine its distribution among testicular germ cell neoplasias and among the intratubular lesions in their vicinity. Our results demonstrated that expression of DAZL1 protein was consistently observed in scattered cells in all intratubular germ cell neoplasias (IGCN) of the unclassified type, as well as in some of the intratubular seminomas. Foci of DAZL1 immunopositive cells were detected in pure seminomas, while single immunopositive cells were dispersed in the seminomatous component of mixed germ cell neoplasias. All the nonseminomatous components were negative for DAZL1 expression. These findings demonstrate an antigenic heterogeneity of seminoma cells. The localization of a specific germ cell protein, DAZL1, in the putative ontogenic progenitor, IGCN, and in their putative derivative, seminoma, provides further support for the hypothesis that IGCN is the precursor of germ cell neoplasias.
abstract_ja: DAZL1は、雌雄の生殖腺に発現する胚細胞特異的タンパク質である。本研究では、精巣胚細胞腫瘍およびその周囲の管内病変におけるDAZL1の分布を免疫組織化学的に検討した。DAZL1タンパク質は、未分類型の管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)のすべてにおいて散在する細胞で一貫して認められ、一部の管内セミノーマにも認められた。純粋セミノーマでは陽性細胞の巣が認められ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ成分では散在する単一の陽性細胞が認められた。非セミノーマ成分はすべてDAZL1陰性であった。これらの所見はセミノーマ細胞の抗原的不均一性を示す。前駆病変であるIGCNおよびその派生物とされるセミノーマにおける特異的胚細胞タンパク質DAZL1の局在は、IGCNが胚細胞腫瘍の前駆体であるとの仮説をさらに支持する。
